build_olmo_model: build an inference-only OLMo model compatible with HuggingFace weights using vLLM
create_olmo_attention: create an OlmoAttention block with QKV projection, rotary embeddings, and attention output projection
create_olmo_mlp: create an OlmoMLP block with merged gate-up projection, SiLU activation, and down projection
create_olmo_decoder_layer: create an OlmoDecoderLayer with self-attention, MLP, and layer norm skip connections
run_olmo_forward: run the OlmoModel forward pass with input IDs, positions, and intermediate tensors for causal LM inference
